name: Simple Template: Exemplar (CR +0)
body:
Exemplars are outsiders who serve the Imperatives, drawing upon the knowledge gathered through ages of cosmic study. This template can be applied to any angel, archon, axiomite, azata, daemon, demon, devil, inevitable, psychopomp, or protean which does not have the tribune template.

Rebuild Rules: The exemplar gains skill ranks equal to twice its Hit Dice which can only be used for Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma-based skills. In addition, by spending a use of one of their spell-like abilities which is not constant or usable at-will as a full-round action, the exemplar may exchange one of their feats for another feat they meet the prerequisites for.
